entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.357 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Sareni, District Rae Bareli.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant on 29.04.2017 and sufficient dowry was also given.
Subsequently, on 13.11.2023, the daughter of the informant was hanged to death by the entire matrimonial family.
The applicant herein is the mother-in-law.
The postmortem report on record indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging and no injury was observed on the body of the deceased except the ligature mark.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Smt. Chhedana Devi @ Angana vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Chhedana Devi @ Angana vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5.Considering the post-mortem report and the fact that there is no allegation that soon before the death, the victim was subjected to any mental or physical harassment in relation to demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is a lady, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Smt. Chhedana Devi @ Angana be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.4.2024 nishant  Smt. Chhedana Devi @ Angana vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
